others.route: Authority to work while on a visitor’s permit

note: Fiji: an entertainer coming to perform needs the Ministry of Immigration's authority to work while on a visitor's permit, for twelve weeks at most from arrival, on proof of tax registration with FIRCA and the relevant authorities' approval for the show (Immigration Act 2003, s. 9); longer work takes a work permit. No days without the authority.

sources.title: Ministry of Immigration (Fiji), Authority to Work or Study while on a Visitors Permit
sources.said: This authority allows non-citizens to be engaged in business or investment, study, research, religious activities or do consultancy works, whilst on a visitors permit for a maximum period of twelve (12) weeks from the date of arrival. ... For entertainers – proof of tax registration from FIRCA and approval from the relevant ... authorities for the conduct of the show.
